title: Does Microsoft’s Massive AI Deal And GPU Build‑Out Change The Bull Case For IREN (IREN)?
title_zh: 微软的大规模人工智能交易和 GPU 建设是否会改变 IREN (IREN) 的牛市？
summary: Iren recently accelerated its shift from Bitcoin mining to AI cloud infrastructure, securing a five‑year US$9.70 billion Microsoft AI data center capacity deal and arranging US$9.30 billion of funding to deploy more than 150,000 Nvidia GPUs across a 4.50 GW power portfolio.
summary_zh: Iren 最近加速了从比特币挖矿向 AI 云基础设施的转变，获得了为期五年、价值 97 亿美元的 Microsoft AI 数据中心容量协议，并安排了 93 亿美元的资金，在 4.50 GW 的电力组合中部署超过 150,000 个 Nvidia GPU。

title: Alliance Entertainment Webinar: Amazon MGM Deal, Margin Gains, and New Authentication Growth Push
title_zh: 联盟娱乐网络研讨会：亚马逊米高梅交易、利润增长和新的身份验证增长推动
summary: Alliance Entertainment (NASDAQ:AENT) used a shareholder webinar to highlight its distribution scale, recent margin gains, and growth initiatives tied to exclusive studio relationships, owned brands, and product authentication technology.
summary_zh: Alliance Entertainment（纳斯达克股票代码：AENT）利用股东网络研讨会强调了其发行规模、近期利润增长以及与独家工作室关系、自有品牌和产品认证技术相关的增长计划。

title: PIMCO weighs $14 billion debt deal for Oracle's Michigan data center, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，PIMCO 考虑以 140 亿美元的债务收购甲骨文密歇根数据中心
summary: Pacific Investment Management Co. is in talks with the Bank of America to help provide roughly $14 ‌billion of debt financing to build an Oracle data ‌center in Michigan, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据彭博社周二援引知情人士的话报道，太平洋投资管理公司正在与美国银行进行谈判，以帮助提供约 140 亿美元的债务融资，以在密歇根州建设甲骨文数据中心。
